units.unit_description: This unit represents a natural gas furnace sized by a useful heat load of 1000 kW, of which 961 kW are delivered as radiant and convective heat above the stack temperature and 39 kW leave with the stack gas. With the wall and hot gas escape losses, the fuel demand is 1250 kW (LHV).
units.connectors_description: The unit takes natural gas and releases CO2: the CO2 of the escaping hot gas is emitted, the CO2 of the flue gas leaves at the stack and can be captured.

units.heat_streams_description: The useful heat is delivered as radiant heat at Trad and as convective heat from Trad to Tstack; the air preheating is a cold stream. The radiant and convective shares of the wall loss and the escaping hot gas are released to the surroundings at Tloss and kept apart from the useful heat (heat cascade LGWH), so they cannot heat the process.
